pages.title: Overview
pages.text:
Nether-themed melee weapon. Base damage 8, attack speed 2.0 (matches Netherite Sword).

Owner effects (not dolls):
• Continuous Fire Resistance while held
• Attacks set target on fire for 4s
• 6 golden hearts (12 absorption) while held
• Hold right-click 1s: summons a flying sword

pages.title: Flying Nether Sword
pages.text:
Orbits the owner. Auto-attacks nearest hostile mob within 16 blocks. Dive-bomb: 8 damage + 8s burn. Only one active at a time.

Repair: blaze rods.

Nether Doll synergy: all burn durations doubled.
